Top-notch team, excellent advice!

I was a little disappointed with the service I received. I needed a Feliway refill. The young man (wearing an "Apprentice" badge) told me there were two types: "serenity" and "calming." Since these terms seemed synonymous, I asked him the difference, and he simply read the names back to me, without any further explanation. I asked him which one he would recommend for a cat at the end of its life, and I got the impression he was just guessing.

Finally, and most importantly, perhaps the grief of losing my cat soon is influencing my experience, but it seems to me that someone working in a pet store, hearing "cat at the end of its life" from a customer with a distraught expression, should at least say, "I'm sorry to hear that."

PS - THANK YOU for your very kind response and comforting words!
Efficient and helpful staff
Helpful and friendly staff. Products available. No problem.

On Tuesday or Wednesday afternoon, I went to the store to look for information about veterinary kibble. I spoke to the manager and asked for advice about a bag of kibble.

When I asked her what it was, she replied very curtly, "It's kibble," without really trying to give me any more information. I tried to soften the approach and rephrase my question, but I got the feeling she just wanted to end the conversation as quickly as possible.

I felt really uncomfortable and annoyed by this attitude, and I left without any further information and without the kibble. As a regular customer of this store, this experience was particularly disappointing and really put me off.
Very courteous and professional staff. Very pleasant.

Living near the store, I often go there for my small dog and cats. The staff is always friendly. However, there's little to no restocking; harnesses, leashes, and carriers for small dogs are often empty. I should mention that I go there very often to look and buy things, but there's nothing. The cosmetics and grooming section is the same. There's a serious lack of choice and restocking. The same goes for leashes; there's nothing for small dogs. It would also be helpful to have a small seat for trying things on, and another thing: it's unbearably hot in your store. I can never find my cat's (diabetic) kibble or Pro Plan puppy food. I only had a home delivery once, and everything arrived crushed. There are very few fun toys for cats as well. Aside from the almost nonexistent restocking of accessories, there's a real lack of variety.

With its new stores, this chain is the closest of its kind to a specialist in pet supplies. The click and collect service is very convenient for items not in stock. If the item isn't suitable, you can return it in-store. It's really convenient.

A big thank you to advisor Enzo, who always greets us with a smile and kindness, offers great advice, and always has a kind word for Merlin.

Hello, I have absolutely nothing to complain about with the team I regularly interact with, but the delivery service is really lacking. There's one driver in particular who delivers three times a week, and with him, it's every man for himself. He has no patience whatsoever. My dog ​​suffered the consequences, and today he even had the nerve to call me crazy! He said I was a mentally ill customer, and this man is also a psychiatrist! That's just unacceptable. Because whatever the reason, he has absolutely no right to pass judgment on customers. But as he so eloquently put it, he doesn't care. There are deliveries to this store, but the other drivers are fine. I'm really disappointed. I go to this store to shop, not to be jostled, let alone insulted. Thankfully, there's a good team that goes above and beyond for our dogs, but this has really put me off, unfortunately. The stars aren't for today's delivery; they're for the team as a whole.
